name: HMI Status and Feedback Signals
description: Standard HMI status outputs: Ready lamp, Running lamp, Fault lamp, Step indicator. Provides clear operator feedback.
safety_notes: Fault_Lamp must be independent from Running_Lamp. Alarm_Beacon should activate on any critical condition. Step_Display helps operators understand sequence progress.
common_mistakes: Fault_Lamp tied to Running state — can miss fault condition
No visual distinction between Ready and Running
